dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask about the Almighty Shogun?

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: The fame of the Almighty Shogun spreads afar throughout the world. She keeps the eternal peace in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: About the Sakoku Decree though... No, never mind. I have no problem with that.

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Of course it's better that we have fewer outlanders to deal with. For the lucky few such as yourself who have come to Inazuma, you must follow the rules here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Almighty Shogun...

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: The fame of the Almighty Shogun spreads afar throughout the world. She keeps the eternal peace in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: I have never once questioned a single one of the Shogun's decisions.

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Even if the Sakoku Decree has been abolished, outlanders who come to Inazuma must still follow its laws.
